aws-compliance.control.dms_endpoint_mong.upstream_defect: The pinned query (source endpoints with MongoDbSettings) alarms when AuthMechanism is 'default' and passes otherwise, without reading AuthType. Corrected native predicate: AuthType is not 'no'.

aws-compliance.control.ec2_instance_no_i.reason: The original control requires that the EC2 instance profile role not allow the listed sensitive actions; controls naming a combination retain that full combination requirement. The pinned evaluator incorrectly reads trust-policy actions instead of the role identity policies. The corrected native checks collected inline policies, attached managed policy default versions, and permissions boundaries using Action/NotAction and Allow/Deny semantics. A proven unconditional identity-policy grant on Resource * is a configuration finding after applicable explicit Deny and boundary checks; it is not proof that a live API call would succeed. SCPs, session policies, and other runtime authorization context are not assessed. A missing or denied profile-to-role or policy inventory join, or a scoped or conditional policy term whose effect cannot be established, yields UNKNOWN. Framework mappings continue to attach to the corrected native.
aws-compliance.control.ec2_instance_no_i.upstream_defect: The query reads the actions of the role's assume_role_policy (trust policy) statements for Principal.Service ec2.amazonaws.com. A trust policy only says who may assume the role (sts:AssumeRole); permissions come from the role's identity policies, so the listed permission actions never appear and the control cannot alarm for a role that actually holds them.
